By this time they were midway between waist and arm-pits and sinking as methodically as ever.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0097", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, somebody’s got to get out of the scrape alive,” Henry remarked.", "sha256": "fb64b4a819c969e68d25d2aa95cc44c5ae0ff6474498d006e210cd66069bcc8a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1242]", "source_html": "

“Well, somebody’s got to get out of the scrape alive,” Henry remarked.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0098", "tag": "p", "text": "And, even without discussing the choice, both men began to hoist Leoncia up, although the effort and her weight thrust them more quickly down. When she stood, free and clear, a foot on the nearest shoulder of each of the two men she loved, Francis said, though the landscape mocked him:", "sha256": "41ffc542347e5b1eeba650a7c94c25aceefa96e2de81ee0162bd488051fb41ed", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1243]", "source_html": "

And, even without discussing the choice, both men began to hoist Leoncia up, although the effort and her weight thrust them more quickly down. When she stood, free and clear, a foot on the nearest shoulder of each of the two men she loved, Francis said, though the landscape mocked him:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0099", "tag": "p", "text": "“Now, Leoncia, we’re going to toss you out of this. At the word ‘Go!’ let yourself go. And you must strike full length and softly on the crust. You’ll slide a little. But don’t let yourself stop. Keep on going. Crawl out to the solid land on your hands and knees. And, whatever you do, don’t stand up until you reach the solid land.—Ready, Henry?”", "sha256": "13eaf938e000171e6a68647666b1e19cb18d8a1d17b2355c4a36c0ff062313d4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1244]", "source_html": "

“Now, Leoncia, we’re going to toss you out of this. At the word ‘Go!’ let yourself go. And you must strike full length and softly on the crust. You’ll slide a little. But don’t let yourself stop. Keep on going. Crawl out to the solid land on your hands and knees. And, whatever you do, don’t stand up until you reach the solid land.—Ready, Henry?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0100", "tag": "p", "text": "Between them, though it hastened their sinking, they swung her back and forth, free in the air, and, the third swing, at Francis’ “Go!” heaved her shoreward.", "sha256": "bb39081272e56a3aabf673e1db3d1600423f9a30f00c45eb2b440de3dd190b65", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1245]", "source_html": "

Between them, though it hastened their sinking, they swung her back and forth, free in the air, and, the third swing, at Francis’ “Go!” heaved her shoreward.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0101", "tag": "p", "text": "Her obedience to their instructions was implicit, and, on hands and knees, she gained the solid rocks of the shore.", "sha256": "65c2fe11560af1280e8158652c263dba0f9f5cc7aa993726ea8f1d52143a7815", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1246]", "source_html": "

Her obedience to their instructions was implicit, and, on hands and knees, she gained the solid rocks of the shore.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0102", "tag": "p", "text": "“Now for the rope!” she called to them.", "sha256": "106b2aa6a2ac097e0cb7322eb7be1e2d5773c9f55cec3aa5dc8f54f4d2eee485", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1247]", "source_html": "

“Now for the rope!” she called to them.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0103", "tag": "p", "text": "But by this time Francis was too deep to be able to remove the coil from around his neck and under one arm. Henry did it for him, and, though the exertion sank him to an equal deepness, managed to fling one end of the rope to Leoncia.", "sha256": "c8653e9b0515594dbe6b255c6d02a38117270b54e3d4ae7a9e25b55ae250d7fa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1248]", "source_html": "

But by this time Francis was too deep to be able to remove the coil from around his neck and under one arm. Henry did it for him, and, though the exertion sank him to an equal deepness, managed to fling one end of the rope to Leoncia.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0104", "tag": "p", "text": "At first she pulled on it. Next, she fastened a turn around a boulder the size of a motor car, and let Henry pull. But it was in vain. The strain or purchase was so lateral that it seemed only to pull him deeper. The quicksand was sucking and rising over his shoulders when Leoncia cried out, precipitating a very Bedlam of echoes:", "sha256": "39946df9d9831d4892de967d0e822036c261a0c8ca41c921676ba5cb49a5544c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1249]", "source_html": "

At first she pulled on it. Next, she fastened a turn 135around a boulder the size of a motor car, and let Henry pull. But it was in vain. The strain or purchase was so lateral that it seemed only to pull him deeper. The quicksand was sucking and rising over his shoulders when Leoncia cried out, precipitating a very Bedlam of echoes:

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0105", "tag": "p", "text": "“Wait! Stop pulling! I have an idea! Give me all the slack! Just save enough of the end to tie under your shoulders!”", "sha256": "649272be283b695625a5cac4f88efd25b26fd785fd29430dc81709746e36d190", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1250]", "source_html": "

“Wait! Stop pulling! I have an idea! Give me all the slack! Just save enough of the end to tie under your shoulders!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0106", "tag": "p", "text": "The next moment, dragging the rope after her by the other end, she was scaling the cliff. Forty feet up, where a gnarled and dwarfed tree rooted in the crevices, she paused. Passing the rope across the tree-trunk, as over a hook, she drew in the slack and made fast to a boulder of several hundredweight.", "sha256": "80bc342fac7f90a73a0c5c8e3194f35a0f7563a914391e066cee8b85a456bac1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1251]", "source_html": "

The next moment, dragging the rope after her by the other end, she was scaling the cliff. Forty feet up, where a gnarled and dwarfed tree rooted in the crevices, she paused. Passing the rope across the tree-trunk, as over a hook, she drew in the slack and made fast to a boulder of several hundredweight.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0107", "tag": "p", "text": "“Good for the girl!” Francis applauded to Henry.", "sha256": "6770ae7a699d3816ff0646466f58e62a3e2ee09e54746d7efe281bc2c052ba89", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1252]", "source_html": "

“Good for the girl!” Francis applauded to Henry.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0108", "tag": "p", "text": "Both men had grasped her plan, and success depended merely on her ability to dislodge the boulder and topple it off the ledge. Five precious minutes were lost, until she could find a dead branch of sufficient strength to serve as a crowbar. Attacking the boulder from behind and working with tense coolness while her two lovers continued to sink, she managed at the last to topple it over the brink.", "sha256": "41a20939d407a7ba0fb3be362f78cbb4d6720989a2915f618a8f69b373bd3698", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1253]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0109", "tag": "p", "text": "As it fell, the rope tautened with a jerk that fetched an involuntary grunt from Henry’s suddenly constricted chest. Slowly, he arose out of the quicksand, his progress being accompanied by loud sucking reports as the sand reluctantly released him. But, when he cleared the surface, the boulder so outweighed him that he shot shoreward across the crust until directly under the purchase above, when the boulder came to rest on the ground beside him.", "sha256": "447aba1a313cb380ec7038d019acecc4491fa63d2b629cd3044da5862b6e0252", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1254]", "source_html": "

And, when he stood beside them on terra firma, and when he shook his fist at the quicksand he had escaped by so narrow a shave, they joined with him in deriding it.
